evidence.artifact_set_definition: Original frozen XAPK bytes, not a hash over APK member hashes
evidence.canonical_path_rule: /analysis is lookup-mapped to the local run root, never rewritten in sealed evidence
evidence.invalid_audit002: Permanently invalid; prior negative candidates/audits remain immutable; no acceptance inheritance
identity_limits: Public Play metadata confirms versionName only, not versionCode, signer, or exact device delivery. Same-version replacement and other device/region deliveries are not excluded.

Complete five-APK arm64-v8a/en/fr/mdpi delivery relative to frozen XAPK and its manifest; not every device-specific delivery. Acquisition record conflates source-stamp and application signer digests; current verification separates them.

hardware: UNVERIFIED; future real-user beta/release checks, not unfinished static implementation
comparison: Separate post-freeze comparison from updated origin/main. No prior family implementation is credited as equivalent to MotoMotion. HA architecture reuse is expressed by concrete code/test groups.

coverage.counting: Ledger identifiers, command rows, aliases and audit checks are overlapping coverage views, never a count of distinct features.

deliberate_ha_corrections.behavior: HA always runs movement release cleanup with fresh events after cancellation/error; the shared Home action has no source release callback and instead ends only its held refresh; it does not suppress cleanup because another gesture changed a global released flag. Exact source MOTOA-vs-MOTO command selection is retained. On name12E binary recall, HA also runs that source-proven cleanup even though the shipped ImageButton binary release returns before its up callback. No new hardware release frame is invented.

Cancellable HA commands own their delayed writes; cancellation prevents unissued writes and old BLE sessions cannot receive writes/events. Current mutable RGB/current prepared D/E command is read at callback time. This prevents app delayed writes surviving a cancelled action.

deliberate_ha_corrections.source: ImageButton saving sendOnRelease immutable recall plus F50927c/F50944c
deliberate_ha_corrections.behavior: HA exposes programming separately and never performs the shipped accidental recall on the release of a save. D uses save slot index1 (264); E uses33050 then263 after300ms. D combined gesture is an explicit bounded3000ms action; local animation/save-mode UI is replaced by explicit programming.

deliberate_ha_corrections.source: F4e683c/F4eb834; source short-MOTO scan acceptance then indexed name9/10
deliberate_ha_corrections.behavior: Reject an incomplete panel-selection name in setup instead of letting a later RangeError select a guessed layout. A scan hint never commits a profile. HA display names never act as GAP names. SOFA flag initialization indexes through14 without a length guard (BaseViewState.initState4d4e38/closure4d4f44); overlapping short BT201/MOTO names therefore also reject rather than inventing missing flags.
Only finite measurements enter the HA user action. ARM head NaN and Dart lumbar clamp NaN remain distinct helper behavior, with no assertion of invalid imported-user action reachability.

deliberate_ha_corrections.source: SpCache global custom EQ/preferences and singleton global device state
deliberate_ha_corrections.behavior: HA scopes persistent users/custom EQ/RGB/binding by physical address and exact profile. It does not let another bed inherit a binding code or private anthropometry. Persistence is a cache/save request, not a durable completion acknowledgment.

HA owns adapters, proxy routing, connection retry/timeouts, CCCD writes and command serialization. Android permissions/status133/activity navigation/periodic100ms state-check timers are not ported. Normal writes propagate backend failure instead of the app bridge false-success return.
